method: Successor scoped source audit. Prior route observations are retained explicitly; current source hashes and newly verified component boundaries are refreshed. This does not reclassify historical Python solely by suffix.

statuses.VERIFIED_NATIVE: Current native entrypoint has declared bounded verification.
statuses.PARTIAL_ROUTE: A native counterpart or component exists, while an active Python/compatibility/deployment route remains.
statuses.PYTHON_ACTIVE_BLOCKER: A current launcher or workflow executes Python with no accepted complete native replacement.
statuses.HISTORICAL_OR_COMPATIBILITY: Retained comparison or package-compatibility source; excluded unless an active launcher invokes it.
statuses.CANDIDATE_UNACCEPTED: Dirty implementation exists but is not route-closure evidence.
